description: This file defines a jQuery plugin called HoverScroll that makes unordered lists scrollable by hovering the mouse over them. It includes plugin initialization, configuration, and destruction methods, along with internal functions for handling scrolling behavior and UI elements like arrows.

methods.name: hoverScroll
methods.description: Main function that initializes the hover scroll behavior on selected elements, setting up event handlers, UI elements, and scrolling logic.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes hover scroll functionality from an element, restoring original DOM structure.
